title: S4-PAL-02 — A library choice is explicit.
goal: Previewing a library palette changes nothing; Use palette selects the palette but not the brush color; clicking one of its swatches sets the Primary color; Bun's artwork never changes.

steps.why: Previewing does not change the brush color.
Previewing does not change the artwork.
The Sakura Night swatches are now the palette.
Use palette selects the palette, not a brush color.
The explicitly clicked swatch becomes the Primary color.
Choosing palettes and colors never edits the artwork.
